STATE BOARD OF ELECTIONS
REFERENDUM CHOICES LIST GROUPED BY REFERENDUM
CRITERIA: Election: 11/03/2026, Show Contest w/o Candidate: N, County: ALL COUNTIES, Data Source: STATE ONLY VIEW
CHOICE DESCRIPTION
CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT - REQUIRE PHOTO ID FOR VOTING
For Constitutional amendment to require all voters, not just those presenting to vote in person, to present photo identification before
voting.
Against Constitutional amendment to require all voters, not just those presenting to vote in person, to present photo identification before
voting.
CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT - MAXIMUM INCOME TAX RATE OF 3.5%
For Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).
Against Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).
CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT - PROPERTY TAX LEVY LIMIT
For Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.
Against Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.
